'''Brother Extok Evin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Flight instructor/Legends|trainer]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Vortex Squadron]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Extok Evin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
